authority_boundary: Checks inspect Lifecycle relationships. Findings are observations until an agent records the interpreted effect in the owning durable record. Product judgment findings belong in the active Work Boundary.

checks.relationship: admitted product judgment and scope in the active Work Boundary permit Build
checks.suggested_owning_movement: return to work-boundary-active

checks.relationship: active Work Boundary states the product judgment that admits behavior before Build
checks.suggested_owning_movement: return to work-boundary-active

checks.relationship: substantive repository edits require a live Work Boundary before Build
checks.suggested_owning_movement: stop, notify founder-dev, and create or select the owning active Work Boundary

checks.relationship: substantive repository edits require live Evidence state for the active run
checks.suggested_owning_movement: stop, notify founder-dev, and create or update the active Evidence Packet

checks.relationship: Context edits in Clarity require a live Clarity Boundary
checks.suggested_owning_movement: stop, notify founder-dev, and create or select the owning active Clarity Boundary

checks.relationship: Context edits in Clarity require live Context Review state when review checks are needed
checks.suggested_owning_movement: stop, notify founder-dev, and create or update the active Context Review Packet

checks.relationship: closed Clarity runs are verified by Clarity checks rather than active live-cadence checks
checks.suggested_owning_movement: run verify clarity for the closed run

checks.relationship: Clarity work starts from a Clarity Boundary before source inventory, Context review, or Context mutation
checks.suggested_owning_movement: create or select the owning Clarity Boundary

checks.relationship: Clarity Control records satisfy source-owned contracts before Context changes are trusted
checks.suggested_owning_movement: repair the owning Clarity Control record

checks.relationship: Clarity inventories source material and the current Context slice before reviewing or mutating Context
checks.suggested_owning_movement: create the Source Inventory before Context review or update

checks.relationship: Clarity records route, content, canonicalization, promotion, retrieval, and freshness review before Context updates are accepted
checks.suggested_owning_movement: create or update the Context Review Packet for the Clarity run

checks.relationship: Context Review Packets verify changes against the Context semantic authority surface contract and the admitted Clarity scope
checks.suggested_owning_movement: repair the Context Review Packet surface contract or scope

checks.relationship: Clarity review depth stays aligned between the boundary and the review packet
checks.suggested_owning_movement: align review depth or record the founder-dev decision that changed it

checks.relationship: Clarity produces inspected Context and recommendations without automatically starting another process
checks.suggested_owning_movement: record the no-auto-start rule or closure confirmation

checks.relationship: closed Clarity runs leave recoverable process state without ambiguous active records
checks.suggested_owning_movement: close, defer, block, supersede, or archive remaining Clarity records

checks.relationship: Discovery Plan Maps represent selected plan state before Delivery handoff
checks.suggested_owning_movement: stop, notify founder-dev, and repair or restart Discovery plan state

checks.relationship: Discovery Selection Handoffs point to live selected plan state before Delivery consumes them
checks.suggested_owning_movement: stop, notify founder-dev, and repair or restart Discovery selection state

checks.relationship: Discovery Selection Handoffs name the Delivery handoff target before consumption
checks.suggested_owning_movement: stop, notify founder-dev, and repair the handoff target before Delivery relies on it

checks.relationship: Work Boundary recommendation basis supports product judgment and follows from visible repo-state evidence
checks.suggested_owning_movement: return to work-boundary-active

checks.relationship: closed Delivery run state is verified by closure checks rather than active scope checks
checks.suggested_owning_movement: run verify closure for the closed run

checks.relationship: final work delta and admitted product judgment are ready for current proof
checks.suggested_owning_movement: return to proof-active or work-boundary-active

checks.relationship: proof obligations map to passed proof receipts
checks.suggested_owning_movement: run proof or record proof gap

checks.relationship: proof receipts remain fresh against changed files, support, config, and contracts
checks.suggested_owning_movement: rerun proof or record stale proof gap

checks.relationship: failed proof attempts remain visible without blocking after current passing proof supersedes them
checks.suggested_owning_movement: keep for debugging or prune generated failed receipts when no longer useful

checks.relationship: an entry's bound check command resolves to a registered proof command
checks.suggested_owning_movement: register the command in the shared tool configuration or fix the entry's Check Command

checks.relationship: the bound proof obligation id appears in the registered command's covers list
checks.suggested_owning_movement: align the command covers list or the entry's Bound Proof Obligation

checks.relationship: entries record last_held date and result without receipt ids
checks.suggested_owning_movement: remove the receipt id and record date and result only

checks.relationship: a Required Check binds obligation id, check command, environment requirement, and last_held
checks.suggested_owning_movement: complete the Required Check binding fields in the owning entry

checks.relationship: current proof and product judgment coverage support landing readiness
checks.suggested_owning_movement: return to proof-active or landing-ready

checks.relationship: active work can close without hidden state
checks.suggested_owning_movement: return to closure-active or release-learning-active

checks.relationship: target repo layout keeps records and local support separate
checks.suggested_owning_movement: repair setup or record placement

checks.relationship: semantic authority entry is adequate for future work
checks.suggested_owning_movement: update owning semantic authority entry

checks.relationship: later surfaces do not carry earlier-surface meaning
checks.suggested_owning_movement: resolve semantic authority backpressure

checks.relationship: semantic authority update obligations are resolved
checks.suggested_owning_movement: update, defer, or mark obligation unnecessary

checks.relationship: selected discipline usage records package, binding, slice, material effect, and proof effect
checks.suggested_owning_movement: complete disciplines_used before relying on selected package material

checks.relationship: discipline usage preserves interpreted effect rather than only a local path
checks.suggested_owning_movement: replace path-only discipline notes with selected package, binding, slice, material effect, and proof effect

checks.relationship: selected discipline resolves to installed package info, binding, surface, and slices
checks.suggested_owning_movement: install selected discipline or repair the selected package, binding, discipline id, version, or slice

checks.relationship: Evidence Packet maps selected discipline proof effects to evidence or explicit rejection
checks.suggested_owning_movement: record discipline_evidence for selected package obligations

checks.relationship: Closure records selected discipline outcome and promotion decision
checks.suggested_owning_movement: record discipline_outcomes before closing the run

checks.relationship: Context entry ids are stable and unique across the Context surface
checks.suggested_owning_movement: canonicalize duplicate Context entries or give distinct entries distinct ids

checks.relationship: Context atlas entries expose area, cluster, role, parent, children, and relations explicitly
checks.suggested_owning_movement: update the affected Context entries with complete atlas fields or record why the entry is intentionally outside the atlas

checks.relationship: Context relations are stable relation:type references a future agent can follow
checks.suggested_owning_movement: repair malformed context_relations or remove relation claims that are not durable

checks.relationship: Context graph relation targets resolve to known Context ids or approved promotion surfaces
checks.suggested_owning_movement: repair relation targets, add missing Context entries, or record the relation as unresolved source material

checks.relationship: Context review labels use a consistent vocabulary future agents can interpret
checks.suggested_owning_movement: replace review_status labels with unreviewed, cluster-reviewed, narrowed, or deprecated

checks.relationship: Context freshness labels use a consistent vocabulary future agents can interpret
checks.suggested_owning_movement: replace freshness labels with needs-cluster-review, current-after-review, stale, or superseded

checks.relationship: Context folders expose neutral folder purpose before topic entries
checks.suggested_owning_movement: add neutral overview.md files to the affected Context folders

checks.relationship: Context atlas structure routes topic leaves through area and cluster folders
checks.suggested_owning_movement: move root topic files into the owning area or cluster route, or record why they are intentionally root-level

manual_fallback: Read the owner page for the check id and perform the listed inspection manually.
